lines.text: I am in no way inferior to the super-apostles, and signs, wonders, and miracles were performed among you.
I am ready to come a third time and will not be a burden, seeking you, not possessions.
Parents should save up for their children, and I will gladly spend my money and my house for your souls.
I urged Timothy to visit you and sent our brother with him, asking whether Timothy exploited you.
I fear quarreling, jealousy, and gossip, and that my God will humble me before you when I come again.
